mission_mode: hybrid demonstration: wheels on smooth terrain, legs on rough terrain

actuator_replacement.method: Quadric edge-collapse simplification of the supplied actuator only; no source files modified.

actuator_mounting: Restored demonstration joint mounts use the authorized reduced RS04 mesh.
foot_policy: Restored visible rubber feet and matching contact spheres are part of the demonstration assembly.
visual_policy: Prior demonstration design restored with procedural wheels, battery enclosure/status lights, hook latches, cover detailing, and scanner hardware. Original source STL and URDF files are unchanged.
demo_additions: four 300 mm tires with beadlock rims and tread
wider axle stance and visual suspension links
top battery cassette with latches, vents, handles and 5-bar charge gauge
dynamics_scope: Assisted chassis velocity/height/attitude and kinematic transformation joints; ideal limb gravity compensation. Visual suspension linkage is not a validated suspension model.
